rules.quote: It sends and receives bytes on a serial line in 8N1 format. 8N1 framing: one start bit (0), eight data bits with the least significant bit first, no parity, one stop bit (1).
rules.statement: Serial frames use 8N1: one start bit (0), eight data bits LSB first, no parity, one stop bit (1).

rules.quote: The bit period is a fixed number of i_clk cycles, set by a parameter. Bit period of PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT clock cycles.
rules.statement: Each bit period lasts PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT i_clk cycles.

rules.quote: The system side has one valid/ready byte stream for transmit and one for receive. Transmit stream input (i_tx_valid, o_tx_ready, i_tx_data) with a valid/ready handshake.
rules.statement: The transmit byte stream uses a valid/ready handshake on i_tx_valid, o_tx_ready and i_tx_data.

rules.quote: The system side has one valid/ready byte stream for transmit and one for receive. Receive stream output (o_rx_valid, i_rx_ready, o_rx_data, o_rx_frame_err).
rules.statement: The receive byte stream uses a valid/ready handshake on o_rx_valid, i_rx_ready, o_rx_data and o_rx_frame_err.

rules.quote: The line is high when idle.
rules.condition: When the serial line is idle
rules.statement: The serial line is held high when idle.

rules.quote: The parameter is fixed at elaboration and its legal range is 4 to 65535.
rules.statement: PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT is fixed at elaboration and must be within the legal range 4 to 65535.

rules.quote: The only transmit storage is the shift register.
rules.statement: The only transmit storage is the shift register, with no additional transmit buffering.

rules.quote: Bytes sent back to back have no idle bit between the stop bit and the next start bit.
rules.condition: When bytes are sent back to back
rules.statement: No idle bit is inserted between the stop bit and the next start bit.

rules.quote: A one-byte holding register keeps each received byte until it is taken.
rules.statement: A one-byte holding register keeps each received byte until it is taken.

rules.quote: A two-flip-flop synchronizer on the asynchronous serial input i_rxd.
rules.statement: The asynchronous input i_rxd passes through a two-flip-flop synchronizer.

rules.quote: Start-bit detection on a falling edge, a second start-bit check in the middle of the bit (glitch rejection), and sampling of every data bit and the stop bit in the middle of the bit.
rules.statement: The receiver detects a start bit on a falling edge and rechecks the start bit in the middle of the bit, rejecting glitches.

rules.quote: Start-bit detection on a falling edge, a second start-bit check in the middle of the bit (glitch rejection), and sampling of every data bit and the stop bit in the middle of the bit.
rules.statement: The receiver samples each data bit and the stop bit in the middle of the bit.

rules.quote: A frame error flag (stop bit sampled as 0), delivered together with the byte.
rules.condition: When the stop bit is sampled as 0
rules.statement: o_rx_frame_err is set and delivered together with the received byte.

rules.quote: An overrun pulse (o_rx_overrun) when a received byte is dropped because the previous byte has not been taken.
rules.condition: When a received byte is dropped because the previous byte has not been taken
rules.statement: o_rx_overrun pulses.

rules.quote: Full duplex: the transmitter and the receiver work at the same time and do not depend on each other.
rules.statement: The transmitter and receiver operate simultaneously and independently of each other (full duplex).

rules.quote: The synchronizer is required by structure, but its metastability behaviour is not checked in simulation.
rules.statement: The synchronizer must be present by structure; its metastability behaviour is not checked in simulation.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT; Default: 16; Legal values: 4 to 65535; Description: Bit period in i_clk cycles (N), used by the transmitter and the receiver
rules.statement: PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT defines the bit period N in i_clk cycles for both transmitter and receiver, default 16, legal range 4 to 65535.

rules.quote: Parameter: LPARA_UART_HALF_BIT; Default: Derived; Legal values: -; Description: PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT / 2 with integer division (floor); the middle-of-bit sampling offset H [REQ-PAR-002] LPARA_UART_HALF_BIT shall equal floor(PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT / 2).
rules.statement: LPARA_UART_HALF_BIT shall equal floor(PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT / 2), the middle-of-bit sampling offset H, using integer division.

rules.quote: [REQ-PAR-001] The block shall behave as specified for every value of PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT from 4 to 65535 inclusive, both odd and even.
rules.condition: PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT is any value from 4 to 65535 inclusive, odd or even
rules.statement: The block shall behave as specified for every PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT value from 4 to 65535, both odd and even.

rules.quote: [REQ-PAR-003] The block should stop elaboration with an error message when PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT is less than 4 or greater than 65535.
rules.condition: PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT is less than 4 or greater than 65535
rules.statement: The block should stop elaboration with an error message when PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT is outside 4 to 65535.

rules.quote: Port: i_rst_n; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Reset (asynchronous assertion, synchronous release); Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Active-low reset
rules.statement: i_rst_n is an active-low reset that asserts asynchronously and releases synchronously to i_clk.

rules.quote: Port: i_tx_valid; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Transmit stream: i_tx_data holds a byte to send Port: o_tx_ready; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 1; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Transmit stream: the transmitter can accept a byte at the next edge
rules.condition: o_tx_ready is high and i_tx_valid is high at a clock edge
rules.statement: When o_tx_ready is 1, the transmitter must accept the byte on i_tx_data at the next i_clk edge.

rules.quote: Port: o_tx_ready; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 1; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Transmit stream: the transmitter can accept a byte at the next edge
rules.statement: o_tx_ready must reset to 1.

rules.quote: Port: i_tx_data; Direction: input; Width: 8; Signal type: Data; Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Transmit stream: byte to send; bit 0 is sent first
rules.statement: Bit 0 of i_tx_data must be sent first on o_txd.

rules.quote: Port: o_rx_valid; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Receive stream: the holding register holds a byte
rules.statement: o_rx_valid must reset to 0.

rules.quote: Port: o_rx_valid; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Receive stream: the holding register holds a byte
rules.statement: o_rx_valid must be 1 when the holding register holds a byte.

rules.quote: Port: i_rx_ready; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Receive stream: the consumer takes the held byte at this edge
rules.condition: i_rx_ready is high at a clock edge with o_rx_valid high
rules.statement: The held byte is taken by the consumer at the edge where i_rx_ready is 1.

rules.quote: Port: o_rx_data; Direction: output; Width: 8; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Receive stream: received byte; bit 0 was received first; qualified by o_rx_valid
rules.statement: o_rx_data must reset to 0.

rules.quote: Port: o_rx_data; Direction: output; Width: 8; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Receive stream: received byte; bit 0 was received first; qualified by o_rx_valid
rules.statement: o_rx_data must present the received byte with bit 0 received first, qualified by o_rx_valid.

rules.quote: Port: o_rx_frame_err; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Receive stream: 1 when the stop bit of the held byte was sampled as 0; qualified by o_rx_valid
rules.statement: o_rx_frame_err must reset to 0.

rules.quote: Port: o_rx_frame_err; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Receive stream: 1 when the stop bit of the held byte was sampled as 0; qualified by o_rx_valid
rules.statement: o_rx_frame_err must be 1 when the stop bit of the held byte was sampled as 0, qualified by o_rx_valid.

rules.quote: Port: o_rx_overrun; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: One-cycle pulse: a received byte was dropped because the holding register was full
rules.statement: o_rx_overrun must reset to 0.

rules.quote: Port: o_rx_overrun; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: One-cycle pulse: a received byte was dropped because the holding register was full
rules.condition: a received byte is dropped because the holding register is full
rules.statement: o_rx_overrun must pulse for one cycle when a received byte is dropped because the holding register is full.

rules.quote: Port: o_txd; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 1; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Serial transmit line, idle high
rules.statement: o_txd must reset to 1 and be high when idle.

rules.quote: Port: i_rxd; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Data (asynchronous); Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: ASYNC; Meaning: Serial receive line, idle high, asynchronous to i_clk, synchronised inside the block
rules.statement: i_rxd, asynchronous to i_clk and idle high, must be synchronised inside the block.

rules.quote: [REQ-CLK-001] All state elements of the block shall be clocked by the rising edge of i_clk only, with no other clock, no gated clock and no latch.
rules.statement: All state elements shall be clocked only by the rising edge of i_clk, with no other clock, no gated clock and no latch.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-001] When i_rst_n becomes 0, every flip-flop of the block shall take its reset value at once, without waiting for an edge of i_clk.
rules.statement: Every flip-flop shall take its reset value at once, without waiting for an i_clk edge.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-002] While i_rst_n is 0, the outputs shall have these values: o_txd = 1, o_tx_ready = 1, o_rx_valid = 0, o_rx_data = 0, o_rx_frame_err = 0, o_rx_overrun = 0.
rules.statement: Outputs shall be o_txd = 1, o_tx_ready = 1, o_rx_valid = 0, o_rx_data = 0, o_rx_frame_err = 0, o_rx_overrun = 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-003] While i_rst_n is 0, no transmit byte shall be accepted, even when i_tx_valid = 1 and o_tx_ready = 1.
rules.condition: While i_rst_n is 0, even when i_tx_valid = 1 and o_tx_ready = 1
rules.statement: No transmit byte shall be accepted.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-004] While i_rst_n is 0, the receiver shall not detect a start bit and shall not deliver a byte.
rules.statement: The receiver shall not detect a start bit and shall not deliver a byte.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-005] Both i_rxd synchronizer flip-flops, and any flip-flop that holds the previous synchronised line value, shall reset to 1.
rules.statement: Both i_rxd synchronizer flip-flops and any flip-flop holding the previous synchronised line value shall reset to 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-006] If reset is asserted during a transmission, the frame shall be abandoned: o_txd shall become 1 at once, and the rest of the frame and the byte shall not be sent after the release.
rules.statement: The frame shall be abandoned and o_txd shall become 1 at once.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-006] If reset is asserted during a transmission, the frame shall be abandoned: o_txd shall become 1 at once, and the rest of the frame and the byte shall not be sent after the release.
rules.statement: The rest of the frame and the byte shall not be sent after the release.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-007] If reset is asserted during a reception, the partly received frame shall be discarded and shall not produce o_rx_valid, o_rx_frame_err or o_rx_overrun after the release.
rules.statement: The partly received frame shall be discarded and shall not produce o_rx_valid, o_rx_frame_err or o_rx_overrun after the release.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-008] If reset is asserted while o_rx_valid = 1, the held byte shall be discarded.
rules.statement: The held byte shall be discarded.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-009] After the release of i_rst_n, the transmitter shall be idle with o_tx_ready = 1, and it shall be able to accept a byte at the first edge after the release.
rules.statement: The transmitter shall be idle with o_tx_ready = 1 and shall accept a byte at the first edge after the release.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-010] After the release of i_rst_n, the receiver shall be idle.
rules.statement: The receiver shall be idle.

rules.quote: For the first edge R1 after the release, s(R1-1) shall be taken as 1 (the reset value of the synchronizer). So if s(R1) = 0, R1 is detected as T0 (Section 10.5).
rules.condition: First edge R1 after reset release
rules.statement: The previous synchronised value s(R1-1) shall be taken as 1, so s(R1) = 0 is detected as T0.

rules.quote: [REQ-GEN-001] The block shall send and receive frames in 8N1 format: a start bit of value 0, then eight data bits with the least significant bit first, then a stop bit of value 1, with no parity bit.
rules.statement: Frames shall be sent and received in 8N1 format: start bit 0, eight data bits LSB first, stop bit 1, no parity bit.

rules.quote: [REQ-GEN-002] The transmitter and the receiver shall work at the same time and independently.
rules.statement: The transmitter and receiver shall operate simultaneously and independently.

rules.quote: No activity of one shall change the timing or the outputs of the other.
rules.statement: Activity of the transmitter shall not change the timing or outputs of the receiver, and vice versa.

rules.quote: [REQ-GEN-003] Every output port shall be driven directly by a flip-flop clocked by i_clk, so there is no combinational path from any input port to any output port.
rules.statement: Every output port shall be driven directly by a flip-flop clocked by i_clk, with no combinational path from any input to any output.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-001] The transmitter shall accept a byte at an edge only when, at that edge, i_tx_valid = 1, o_tx_ready = 1 and i_rst_n = 1.
rules.statement: The transmitter shall accept a byte at an edge only when i_tx_valid = 1, o_tx_ready = 1 and i_rst_n = 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-002] The transmitter shall capture i_tx_data at the accepting edge E0. The value of i_tx_data at any other edge shall have no effect.
rules.statement: The transmitter shall capture i_tx_data at the accepting edge E0; i_tx_data at any other edge shall have no effect.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-003] While the transmitter is idle (no frame in progress), o_tx_ready shall be 1.
rules.condition: transmitter idle, no frame in progress
rules.statement: o_tx_ready shall be 1 while the transmitter is idle.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-004] After an accepting edge E0, o_tx_ready shall be 0 in the cycles after edges E0 to E0+10N-2 inclusive.
rules.statement: o_tx_ready shall be 0 in the cycles after edges E0 to E0+10N-2 inclusive.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-005] After an accepting edge E0, o_tx_ready shall become 1 at edge E0+10N-1, which is the last cycle of the stop bit.
rules.statement: o_tx_ready shall become 1 at edge E0+10N-1, the last cycle of the stop bit.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-006] If i_tx_valid is 0 at an edge, or o_tx_ready is 0 at that edge, the transmitter shall not accept a byte and its state shall not depend on i_tx_data.
rules.condition: i_tx_valid is 0 or o_tx_ready is 0 at an edge
rules.statement: The transmitter shall not accept a byte and its state shall not depend on i_tx_data.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-007] The transmitter shall not require i_tx_valid to stay 1 until a handshake. If i_tx_valid returns to 0 before a handshake, nothing is sent.
rules.statement: The transmitter shall not require i_tx_valid to stay 1 until a handshake; if it returns to 0 before a handshake, nothing is sent.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-008] The transmitter shall hold at most one byte, the byte being sent, and shall have no transmit buffer beyond it.
rules.statement: The transmitter shall hold at most one byte, the one being sent, with no additional transmit buffer.

rules.quote: Frame bit j (j = 0 to 9) of a byte D is: bit 0 = 0 (start bit); bit j = D[j-1] for j = 1 to 8; bit 9 = 1 (stop bit). [REQ-TX-010] For a byte D accepted at edge E0, o_txd in the cycle after edge E0+k shall equal frame bit floor(k / N) of D, for every k from 0 to 10N-1.
rules.condition: byte D accepted at edge E0
rules.statement: o_txd in the cycle after edge E0+k shall equal frame bit floor(k/N) of D (bit0=0, bit j=D[j-1], bit9=1) for k from 0 to 10N-1.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-011] Each of the 10 frame bits shall be driven on o_txd for exactly N consecutive cycles.
rules.statement: Each of the 10 frame bits shall be driven on o_txd for exactly N consecutive cycles.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-012] If a new byte is accepted at edge E0+10N, its start bit shall begin at edge E0+10N, with no idle cycle between the stop bit of the previous frame and the new start bit.
rules.condition: new byte accepted at edge E0+10N
rules.statement: The start bit of the new frame shall begin at edge E0+10N with no idle cycle after the previous stop bit.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-013] If no byte is accepted at edge E0+10N, o_txd shall be 1 from edge E0+10N until the edge after which the next accepted frame starts.
rules.condition: no byte accepted at edge E0+10N
rules.statement: o_txd shall be 1 from edge E0+10N until the edge after which the next accepted frame starts.

rules.quote: [REQ-TX-014] While the transmitter is idle, o_txd shall be 1.
rules.statement: o_txd shall be 1 while the transmitter is idle.

rules.section_title: Receive line synchronisation and start detection
rules.quote: [REQ-RX-001] i_rxd shall go through a synchronizer of exactly two flip-flops clocked by i_clk, with no logic between them, before any other logic of the block uses it.
rules.statement: i_rxd shall pass through a synchronizer of exactly two flip-flops clocked by i_clk, with no logic between them, before other logic uses it.

rules.section_title: Receive line synchronisation and start detection
rules.quote: [REQ-RX-002] The receiver shall be in one of two conditions, idle or receiving. It shall be idle after reset, after a glitch (REQ-RX-005) and after the stop-bit sample of a frame (REQ-RX-013).
rules.statement: The receiver shall be either idle or receiving, and shall be idle after reset, after a glitch and after the stop-bit sample of a frame.

rules.section_title: Receive line synchronisation and start detection
rules.quote: [REQ-RX-003] While idle, the receiver shall detect a start bit at edge T0 if and only if s(T0-1) = 1 and s(T0) = 0.
rules.statement: The receiver shall detect a start bit at edge T0 if and only if s(T0-1)=1 and s(T0)=0.

rules.section_title: Receive line synchronisation and start detection
rules.quote: [REQ-RX-004] The receiver shall not need the line to be high for longer than the single sample s(T0-1) = 1 before a start bit.
rules.statement: The receiver shall not need the line high longer than the single sample s(T0-1)=1 before a start bit.

rules.section_title: Receive line synchronisation and start detection
rules.quote: [REQ-RX-005] At edge T0+H the receiver shall check the start bit. If s(T0+H) = 1, the receiver shall treat the event as a glitch, return to idle and receive no byte.
rules.statement: At T0+H the receiver shall check the start bit; if s(T0+H)=1 it shall treat it as a glitch, return to idle and receive no byte.

rules.section_title: Receive line synchronisation and start detection
rules.quote: [REQ-RX-006] A glitch shall not change o_rx_valid, o_rx_data or o_rx_frame_err, and it shall not make o_rx_overrun pulse.
rules.statement: A glitch shall not change o_rx_valid, o_rx_data or o_rx_frame_err, and shall not make o_rx_overrun pulse.

rules.section_title: Receive line synchronisation and start detection
rules.quote: [REQ-RX-007] After a glitch checked at edge T0+H, the receiver shall detect a new start bit at any edge T0' > T0+H at which REQ-RX-003 holds.
rules.condition: after a glitch checked at T0+H
rules.statement: The receiver shall detect a new start bit at any edge T0' > T0+H at which the start condition holds.

rules.section_title: Receive line synchronisation and start detection
rules.quote: [REQ-RX-008] If s(T0+H) = 0, the receiver shall go on to receive the frame.
rules.statement: The receiver shall go on to receive the frame.

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-010] For a frame detected at T0 and confirmed at T0+H, the receiver shall sample data bit i (i = 0 to 7) at edge T0+H+(i+1)N. The received byte bit i shall be s(T0+H+(i+1)N).
rules.condition: frame detected at T0 and confirmed at T0+H
rules.statement: Data bit i (0 to 7) shall be sampled at edge T0+H+(i+1)N, and received byte bit i shall equal s(T0+H+(i+1)N).

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-011] The receiver shall sample the stop bit at edge M = T0+H+9N.
rules.statement: The receiver shall sample the stop bit at edge M = T0+H+9N.

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-012] Only the samples s(T0-1), s(T0), s(T0+H), the eight data-bit samples and s(M) shall affect the result of a frame. Values of i_rxd at all other edges between T0 and M shall be ignored.
rules.statement: Only s(T0-1), s(T0), s(T0+H), the eight data samples and s(M) shall affect a frame result; i_rxd at other edges between T0 and M shall be ignored.

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-013] Once it has sampled the stop bit at M, the receiver shall be idle. It shall detect a new start bit at any edge T0' > M at which REQ-RX-003 holds, including T0' = M+1 when s(M) = 1 and s(M+1) = 0.
rules.statement: The receiver shall be idle after sampling at M and shall detect a new start bit at any T0' > M where the start condition holds, including M+1.

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-014] Every frame confirmed at T0+H shall complete at M, whatever the value of s(M).
rules.statement: Every confirmed frame shall complete at M regardless of the value of s(M).

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-015] The receiver shall keep sampling and receiving frames while a byte is waiting in the holding register. A low i_rx_ready shall not stall or delay the receiver.
rules.statement: The receiver shall keep sampling and receiving frames; a low i_rx_ready shall not stall or delay it.

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-020] At the delivery edge V = M+2 of a completed frame, if o_rx_valid = 0, the block shall load the frame into the holding register. o_rx_valid then becomes 1, o_rx_data becomes the received byte and o_rx_frame_err becomes the inverse of s(M).
rules.condition: at delivery edge V=M+2 with o_rx_valid=0
rules.statement: The block shall load the frame: o_rx_valid becomes 1, o_rx_data the received byte, o_rx_frame_err the inverse of s(M).

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-021] At the delivery edge V of a completed frame, if o_rx_valid = 1 and i_rx_ready = 1, the block shall take the held byte and load the new frame into the holding register at the same edge. o_rx_valid stays 1 and no overrun is reported.
rules.condition: at delivery edge V with o_rx_valid=1 and i_rx_ready=1
rules.statement: The held byte shall be taken and the new frame loaded at the same edge; o_rx_valid stays 1 and no overrun is reported.

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-022] The consumer takes a held byte at an edge where o_rx_valid = 1, i_rx_ready = 1 and i_rst_n = 1. [REQ-RX-023] If a held byte is taken at an edge and no new byte is loaded at that edge, o_rx_valid shall become 0 at that edge.
rules.condition: held byte taken (o_rx_valid=1, i_rx_ready=1, i_rst_n=1) and no new byte loaded
rules.statement: o_rx_valid shall become 0 at that edge.

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-024] While o_rx_valid = 1 and the byte is not taken, o_rx_valid, o_rx_data and o_rx_frame_err shall keep their values.
rules.statement: o_rx_valid, o_rx_data and o_rx_frame_err shall keep their values.

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-025] o_rx_data and o_rx_frame_err shall change only at an edge where a new byte is loaded, or on reset. While o_rx_valid = 0 they shall keep the values of the last loaded byte, or 0 if no byte has been loaded since reset.
rules.statement: o_rx_data and o_rx_frame_err shall change only when a new byte is loaded or on reset, keeping the last loaded values (0 after reset) while o_rx_valid=0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-026] i_rx_ready shall have no effect while o_rx_valid = 0.
rules.statement: i_rx_ready shall have no effect while o_rx_valid=0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RX-027] Bytes shall be delivered on the receive stream in the order in which their frames completed.
rules.statement: Bytes shall be delivered in the order in which their frames completed.

rules.quote: [REQ-FE-001] o_rx_frame_err shall be 1 with a loaded byte if and only if the stop-bit sample s(M) of that frame was 0.
rules.statement: o_rx_frame_err shall be 1 with a loaded byte if and only if s(M) of that frame was 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-FE-002] A byte with a frame error shall be delivered, held and taken like any other byte, and o_rx_data shall hold its sampled data bits.
rules.statement: The byte shall be delivered, held and taken like any other byte, and o_rx_data shall hold its sampled data bits.

rules.quote: [REQ-FE-003] After a frame with a frame error, the receiver shall not detect a new start bit until s has been 1 at one edge and 0 at the next edge (REQ-RX-003), so a line held at 0 produces exactly one frame.
rules.condition: after a frame with frame error
rules.statement: The receiver shall not detect a new start bit until s is 1 at one edge and 0 at the next, so a line held at 0 produces exactly one frame.

rules.quote: [REQ-OVR-001] At the delivery edge V of a completed frame, if o_rx_valid = 1 and i_rx_ready = 0, the block shall drop the new byte and its frame-error flag.
rules.condition: at delivery edge V with o_rx_valid=1 and i_rx_ready=0
rules.statement: The block shall drop the new byte and its frame-error flag.

rules.quote: [REQ-OVR-002] When a byte is dropped at edge V, o_rx_overrun shall become 1 at edge V and return to 0 at edge V+1, so it is 1 for exactly one cycle.
rules.statement: o_rx_overrun shall become 1 at edge V and return to 0 at V+1, being 1 for exactly one cycle.

rules.quote: [REQ-OVR-003] When a byte is dropped, o_rx_valid, o_rx_data and o_rx_frame_err shall keep the held byte unchanged.
rules.statement: o_rx_valid, o_rx_data and o_rx_frame_err shall keep the held byte unchanged.

rules.quote: [REQ-OVR-004] o_rx_overrun shall be 0 in every cycle except the cycle after an edge at which a byte is dropped.
rules.statement: o_rx_overrun shall be 0 in every cycle except the cycle after an edge at which a byte is dropped.

rules.quote: [REQ-OVR-005] o_rx_overrun shall not be qualified by o_rx_valid and shall not need a handshake.
rules.statement: o_rx_overrun shall not be qualified by o_rx_valid and shall not need a handshake.

rules.quote: [REQ-OVR-006] A glitch, and a frame cut short by reset, shall not make o_rx_overrun pulse.
rules.condition: glitch or frame cut short by reset
rules.statement: o_rx_overrun shall not pulse.

rules.quote: Latency: the start bit starts on o_txd at the accepting edge E0, which means in the first cycle after the handshake.
rules.condition: a byte is accepted at edge E0 (handshake)
rules.statement: The start bit must appear on o_txd in the first cycle after the accepting handshake edge E0.

rules.quote: Frame length: 10N cycles. The stop bit ends at edge E0+10N.
rules.condition: a byte is accepted at edge E0
rules.statement: The transmit frame must last 10N cycles, with the stop bit ending at edge E0+10N.

rules.quote: o_tx_ready is 0 for 10N-1 cycles after E0 and becomes 1 in the last cycle of the stop bit (REQ-TX-004, REQ-TX-005).
rules.condition: a byte is accepted at edge E0
rules.statement: o_tx_ready must be 0 for 10N-1 cycles after E0 and become 1 in the last cycle of the stop bit.

rules.quote: Back-pressure: while o_tx_ready = 0, the upstream block waits; the block never drops an offered byte.
rules.condition: o_tx_ready = 0 while a byte is offered
rules.statement: The block must never drop an offered byte while o_tx_ready = 0; the upstream block waits.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-001] While i_tx_valid is held at 1, the transmitter shall accept one byte every 10N cycles and shall produce a continuous stream of frames with no idle cycle between them.
rules.statement: The transmitter must accept one byte every 10N cycles and produce a continuous stream of frames with no idle cycle between them.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-002] Bytes shall be sent on o_txd in the order in which they were accepted.
rules.statement: Bytes must be sent on o_txd in the order in which they were accepted.

rules.quote: Latency: from start-bit detection T0 to delivery V = T0 + H + 9N + 2 edges. Measured from the stop-bit sample M, this is 2 edges: the synchronizer latency.
rules.statement: Delivery must occur at V = T0 + H + 9N + 2 edges, which is 2 edges after the stop-bit sample M.

rules.quote: Smallest spacing between two detected start bits: H + 9N + 1 cycles (REQ-RX-013). A transmitter that runs slightly fast is therefore accepted.
rules.condition: two start bits are spaced at least H + 9N + 1 cycles apart
rules.statement: The receiver must detect a start bit at the smallest spacing of H + 9N + 1 cycles, so a slightly fast transmitter is accepted.

rules.quote: [REQ-TIM-003] The receiver shall accept frames back to back with no idle bit between them: a stop bit followed at once by the next start bit, each bit N cycles long.
rules.condition: a stop bit is followed at once by the next start bit, each bit N cycles long
rules.statement: The receiver must accept frames back to back with no idle bit between them.

rules.section_title: Receive example (N = 4, H = 2, received byte 0xA5, stop bit 1)
rules.quote: If at V the holding register was full and i_rx_ready = 0, then after V o_rx_overrun = 1 for one cycle and the held byte is unchanged.
rules.condition: at delivery V the holding register is full and i_rx_ready = 0
rules.statement: After V, o_rx_overrun must be 1 for one cycle and the held byte must remain unchanged.

rules.quote: The block has no software-visible registers.
rules.statement: The block must not provide any software-visible registers.

rules.quote: Detection: the stop-bit sample s(M) is 0. Response: the byte is delivered with o_rx_frame_err = 1 (REQ-FE-001, REQ-FE-002).
rules.statement: When the stop-bit sample s(M) is 0, the byte is delivered with o_rx_frame_err = 1.

rules.quote: Detection: a frame completes and, at its delivery edge V, o_rx_valid = 1 and i_rx_ready = 0. Response: the new byte is dropped, o_rx_overrun pulses for one cycle and the held byte stays (REQ-OVR-001 to REQ-OVR-003).
rules.condition: a frame completes at delivery edge V with o_rx_valid = 1 and i_rx_ready = 0
rules.statement: The new byte is dropped, o_rx_overrun pulses for one cycle and the held byte stays.

rules.quote: If the held byte is taken at V itself, there is no overrun (REQ-RX-021).
rules.condition: held byte is taken at delivery edge V itself
rules.statement: No overrun occurs if the held byte is taken at V itself.

rules.quote: The frame-error flag of a dropped byte is not reported.
rules.statement: The frame-error flag of a dropped byte is not reported.

rules.quote: Detection: s(T0+H) = 1. Response: no byte, no flag and no pulse (REQ-RX-005, REQ-RX-006).
rules.statement: On a start-bit glitch, no byte, no flag and no pulse is produced.

rules.quote: A low pulse on i_rxd that is sampled at fewer than H+1 edges in a row, starting at T0, is always rejected.
rules.condition: low pulse on i_rxd sampled at fewer than H+1 edges in a row, starting at T0
rules.statement: A low pulse on i_rxd sampled at fewer than H+1 consecutive edges starting at T0 is always rejected.

rules.section_title: Line held low (break) and stuck line
rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-001] If i_rxd stays 0 from a start bit through the whole frame, the receiver shall deliver the byte 0x00 with o_rx_frame_err = 1, or drop it with an overrun pulse under the rules of Section 7.8.
rules.condition: i_rxd stays 0 from a start bit through the whole frame
rules.statement: The receiver delivers byte 0x00 with o_rx_frame_err = 1, or drops it with an overrun pulse under Section 7.8 rules.

rules.section_title: Line held low (break) and stuck line
rules.quote: After that it shall receive no further frame until the line has been sampled as 1 and then as 0.
rules.condition: after a frame with i_rxd held low, until line sampled as 1 then 0
rules.statement: The receiver receives no further frame until the line has been sampled as 1 and then as 0.

rules.section_title: Line held low (break) and stuck line
rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-002] If i_rxd stays 1, the receiver shall stay idle and deliver nothing.
rules.statement: The receiver stays idle and delivers nothing.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-003] If s(R1) = 0 at the first edge R1 after the release of i_rst_n, the receiver shall detect R1 as T0 (REQ-RST-010) and process the frame under Sections 7.4 to 7.8. A line that stays low therefore produces one byte 0x00 with o_rx_frame_err = 1.
rules.condition: s(R1) = 0 at first edge R1 after release of i_rst_n
rules.statement: The receiver detects R1 as T0 and processes the frame under Sections 7.4 to 7.8; a line staying low yields one byte 0x00 with o_rx_frame_err = 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-004] When i_tx_valid = 1 while o_tx_ready = 0, the transmitter shall not accept the byte and shall not record it.
rules.statement: The transmitter shall not accept the byte and shall not record it.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-005] When i_rx_ready = 1 while o_rx_valid = 0, the block shall do nothing (REQ-RX-026).
rules.statement: The block shall do nothing.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-006] A transmit handshake and a receive delivery or take in the same cycle shall be handled independently (REQ-GEN-002).
rules.condition: transmit handshake and receive delivery or take in the same cycle
rules.statement: Transmit handshake and receive delivery or take in the same cycle shall be handled independently.

rules.quote: A frame lasts 655350 cycles. [REQ-ERR-007] Bit-period and sample-offset counting shall not overflow or wrap early at N = 65535.
rules.statement: Bit-period and sample-offset counting shall not overflow or wrap early at N = 65535.

rules.quote: Values outside 4 to 65535 are illegal (REQ-PAR-003).
rules.statement: Values of N outside 4 to 65535 are illegal and must not be used.

rules.quote: ID: CFG-MIN; Parameter values: PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT=4; Purpose: Smallest legal bit period; minimum sampling margins
rules.statement: CFG-MIN with PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT=4 is the smallest legal bit period and must be verified for minimum sampling margins.

rules.statement: The largest legal PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT value (65535) is covered by elaboration and synthesis only, not by simulation; CFG-WIDE uses 1024.

rules.quote: [ENV-001] The environment shall release i_rst_n (0 to 1) synchronously to i_clk, meeting recovery and removal times.
rules.statement: The environment shall release i_rst_n synchronously to i_clk, meeting recovery and removal times.

rules.statement: The environment shall drive i_tx_valid, i_tx_data and i_rx_ready synchronously to i_clk with no X or Z values.

rules.statement: The testbench shall change i_rxd away from rising edges of i_clk, e.g. on the falling edge or at a non-coincident random offset.

rules.quote: [ENV-004] In simulation, the testbench shall change i_rxd away from rising edges of i_clk (for example on the falling edge or at a random offset that does not coincide with a rising edge), so that s(E) is well defined. i_rxd shall not be X or Z after reset release.
rules.statement: i_rxd shall not be X or Z after reset release.

rules.statement: The environment need not keep i_tx_valid or i_tx_data stable before a handshake, and may assert i_rx_ready at any time.

rules.quote: The synchronizer depth can be seen at the ports only as the fixed latency V = M + 2.
rules.statement: The synchronizer depth is observable at the ports only as the fixed latency V = M + 2.

rules.statement: The synchronizer structure (exactly two flip-flops, no logic between them, REQ-RX-001) shall be checked by lint or structural review.

rules.quote: The receiver's idle/receiving condition and its sampling edges can be seen only through the delivered bytes, flags and pulses.
rules.statement: The receiver idle/receiving condition and sampling edges are observable only through delivered bytes, flags and pulses.

rules.statement: The reference model shall compute s(E) from i_rxd and apply Sections 7.4 to 7.8 exactly.

rules.statement: The checker shall check REQ-TX-004, REQ-TX-005 and REQ-TX-010 cycle by cycle.

rules.statement: Loopback test: connect o_txd to i_rxd and check the Section 8.5 latency and byte integrity.

rules.statement: Reset tests: assert i_rst_n asynchronously between clock edges in mid-transmit frame, mid-receive frame and while o_rx_valid = 1.

rules.statement: Test line low at reset release (REQ-ERR-003) and break (REQ-ERR-001).

rules.statement: Cover back-to-back transmit with i_tx_valid held at 1, and transmit with idle gaps of various lengths.

rules.statement: Cover frame error with o_rx_valid = 0, and frame error with the byte dropped by overrun.

rules.statement: Cover overrun, and the case where the held byte is taken at delivery edge V itself (no overrun).

rules.statement: Cover i_rx_ready held at 1, toggling at random, and held at 0 for several frames.

rules.statement: Cover i_tx_valid dropping before a handshake.

rules.statement: Cover transmit and receive active at the same time.

rules.quote: [REQ-IMP-001] The block shall meet timing at 50 MHz (20 ns period) on GF180MCU for every legal value of PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT.
rules.condition: for every legal value of PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT
rules.statement: The block shall meet timing at 50 MHz (20 ns period) on GF180MCU for every legal value of PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT.

uart_lite is a small UART for a single-clock SoC.
Parity, 5/6/7-bit data, two stop bits and any other frame format.
Changing the baud rate at run time, fractional baud-rate generation and automatic baud detection.
Hardware flow control (RTS/CTS), XON/XOFF, and a separate break-detect output.
Majority-vote or oversampling noise filtering beyond the single middle-of-bit sample and the start-bit check.
Transmit or receive FIFOs deeper than the transmit shift register and the single receive holding register.
Software-visible registers, a bus interface and interrupts.
Any stated tolerance to baud-rate mismatch beyond what follows from the sampling points in Section 7.5.
Metastability modelling.

Term: N; Meaning: Short name for PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT, the bit period in i_clk cycles
Term: H; Meaning: Short name for LPARA_UART_HALF_BIT = floor(N / 2), the offset of the middle-of-bit sampling point
Term: Edge; Meaning: A rising edge of i_clk. Edges are numbered in order, so E+1 is the edge after edge E
Term: Cycle after edge E; Meaning: The clock period that starts at edge E and ends at edge E+1. A registered output that "becomes X at edge E" has value X in the cycle after edge E
Term: Value at edge E; Meaning: The value of a synchronous input sampled at edge E
Term: Handshake (transmit); Meaning: An edge at which i_tx_valid = 1, o_tx_ready = 1 and i_rst_n = 1. The byte on i_tx_data is accepted
Term: Accepting edge E0; Meaning: The edge at which a transmit handshake takes place
Term: Take (receive); Meaning: An edge at which o_rx_valid = 1, i_rx_ready = 1 and i_rst_n = 1. The held byte leaves the block
Term: Frame; Meaning: Start bit, 8 data bits and stop bit: 10 bits, each N cycles long
Term: s(E); Meaning: The value of i_rxd captured by the first synchronizer flip-flop at edge E
Term: T0; Meaning: The edge at which the receiver detects the falling edge of a start bit: s(T0-1) = 1 and s(T0) = 0 while the receiver is idle
Term: M; Meaning: The stop-bit sampling edge of a frame, M = T0 + H + 9N
Term: V; Meaning: The delivery edge of a frame, V = M + 2. The 2 is the synchronizer latency
Term: Glitch; Meaning: A detected falling edge whose start-bit check s(T0 + H) gives 1
Term: Frame error; Meaning: A completed frame whose stop-bit sample s(M) is 0
Term: Overrun; Meaning: A completed frame that is dropped because the holding register is full and is not being emptied at its delivery edge V
Term: Holding register; Meaning: The one-byte receive output register behind o_rx_data, o_rx_frame_err and o_rx_valid
Behaviour for illegal values is not specified and is not verified.
m_uart_lite: all ports (CLK)
Port: i_clk; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Clock; Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Clock, rising edge
The block has one clock, i_clk, which defines the clock domain CLK.
All flip-flops are clocked on the rising edge of i_clk.
The target frequency is 50 MHz (Section 13).
Every port is synchronous to i_clk except i_rxd, which is asynchronous and is synchronised inside the block (Section 7.4).
The bit rate is f(i_clk) / N.
For example, at 50 MHz, N = 16 gives 3.125 Mbit/s and N = 434 gives about 115200 bit/s.
i_rst_n is active low.
Its assertion is asynchronous.
Its release is synchronous to i_clk: the release is synchronised outside the block (ENV-001), and the block contains no reset synchronizer.
Back-pressure: there is one holding register.
To avoid an overrun, the consumer has to take a byte before the delivery edge of the next frame.
D = 0xA5 = 1010_0101b, so data bits sent first to last are 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1.
The byte is accepted at edge E0.

If i_rxd is connected directly to o_txd, then T0 = E0+1 and the byte is delivered at edge E0 + H + 9N + 3.
With N = 4 this is E0+41.
Section 6.2 covers this (REQ-RST-006 to REQ-RST-008).
A frame cut short on o_txd may cause a frame error in the remote receiver; that is outside this block.
The upstream block has to keep offering it.
N = 4 (minimum): H = 2.
When the bit period is exact, each sample is taken 2 edges after the first edge of the bit and 1 edge before its last edge.
A frame lasts 40 cycles, and the smallest spacing between start bits is 39 cycles.
N odd (for example 5): H = floor(N/2) = 2, which is exactly the centre of the bit.
